title: Beauty Product Video Ads for Skincare | AIVideosUGC
description: Make beauty product video ads that show your serum, cream, or oil in a calm daily routine. Upload a photo and get a 9:16 clip for TikTok or Reels. Start now.
h1: Beauty Product Video Ads Built Around a Daily Routine
lead: Beauty product video ads work best when they show your serum, cream, or oil as part of a quiet self-care moment. Share a product shot, sketch the bathroom scene in a few words, and receive a 9:16 clip for TikTok and Reels.
intro: This one films a quiet self-care moment with your product at the center. In our sample, a woman in a white robe lifts a dropper from an amber serum bottle in a bright, sunlit bathroom.

Routine clips feel at home on TikTok and Instagram because they look like something a friend might post. They let shoppers see the packaging, the dropper or pump, and where the product sits in someone's morning or evening. Close shots of two drops on a fingertip, or a swatch on the back of a hand, show texture in a way still photos can't.
tip: Use a photo where the bottle shape, cap, and color are easy to see, and describe the action, such as "lifts the dropper and adds two drops to her fingertips."

steps.d: A sharp shot of the bottle by itself helps the video hold on to its color, cap, and shape.
Set the person, the light, and the gesture, like "woman in a robe, morning light, applies serum." Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
Add a track, your product name, and any on-screen words yourself before the clip goes live.

ideas.d: Swap the sunlight for a dim bedside lamp to show a night cream or an overnight mask.
Ask for a hand pressing a pump or dipping into a jar so buyers can see the cream or gel.
Use the same idea for a body oil after a shower or a hair serum worked through damp ends.

faq.q: Can the video show before-and-after skin results?
faq.a: No. This template shows how a product is used, not what it does to skin. Keep any words you add the same way: describe the product and the routine, and leave out promises about results.

faq.q: Does this work for makeup too?
faq.a: Yes. Lipsticks, compacts, palettes, and brushes all work. Describe one moment, like "swipes lipstick in a hand mirror," and keep each clip to a single product.

faq.q: How do I add music and my product name?
faq.a: Do it after you download. AIVideosUGC doesn't add a music track or text to the clip, so pick a track and type your product name in CapCut or in the TikTok app.

faq.q: What product photo works best for a beauty video ad?
faq.a: Use a sharp, front-facing photo with the full package visible and little glare. Keep claims out of the prompt; add only verified product wording later in your editor.
